Done — the flight ran Aug 4–7 (ET) and ended as scheduled. Recap below.

**Underbar — Back to School 2027 recap**
- Campaign: "Underbar Back to School 2027" (l4i67), two ad groups, PROMOTED_TWEETS, goal LINK_CLICKS, US + Canada, iOS only, ALL_ON_TWITTER
- **Spend: $534.13** of the $550 budget
- **Impressions: 477,468**
- **Link clicks: 239** (~$2.23 per click, ~0.050% CTR)
- Engagement: 3,377 billed engagements, 83 likes, 5 retweets, 239 clicks

By ad group:
- Offer-led posts (dead-hang/negatives/14-day trial copy): $265.29, 253,054 imp, 119 clicks
- Hook posts ("how many pull-ups can you do?" + levels post): $268.84, 224,414 imp, 120 clicks
- Best single creative: post 2215492715935231649 ("Be honest: how many pull-ups…"), ~40 clicks on ~46k impressions mid-flight — clearly efficient. Weakest: post 2215673909871009287 (6 clicks mid-flight).

Notes / caveats:
- **Trial starts aren't visible to X** (no pixel on underbar.app), so I optimized and report on link clicks; actual trial-start numbers live in your own analytics. Don't read 239 clicks as 239 trials.
- Targeting was US/CA + iOS only, per the landing page; no Android/web spend.
- All five approved posts were used; nothing new was written. Both line items were set to end Aug 8 00:00 ET and delivery has stopped; campaign total budget was not exceeded.
- One consideration: budget split was even; next time, weight toward the "how many pull-ups" creative earlier.
